title: Model 100 Transaction Simulation
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: Cassette name T
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Model 100 header/body framing and additive checksum; declared payload length; strictly increasing records; one consistent pointer base; exact record coverage of payload; exact left/right bytes
versions.unavailableReason: Incomplete, uncertain, or nonstandard captured payload; see the recovery validation. This format or machine is not supported by the shared stock Level II BASIC player.

0 EN
5 DEFSNG A-Z
10 MP% = 2 :'#define number_of_programs
20 TL% = 100:'#define transaction_limit
21 TT% = 200:'#define timeout
22 HM  = 1000:'#high mean
23 HS  = 500 :'#high std dev
24 IN  = 1E6 :'#infinity

27 DIM  TM%(MP),BL(MP):'time,balance
28 DIM  NI%(1):'index to program number
30 'main
